holderQuote: Weight. Gravity. Pryde raised her hand.
effectQuote: The force crushed the Chief down. It would have killed most Humans; and the weight was more intense the closer he got to Pryde. But he was an Ogre! The monster roared, lifting an arm. Furious now, he raised his hammer. He forgot about his lust and swung with all his might.
Pryde’s back began to straighten, and the reservoir of ego she had spent in battle returned.
